text: Objectives The undergraduate program in International Trade and Economics provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge in economics and international trade. The program covers business related issues such as Chinese culture, China's policies on foreign trade, and China’s major trading partners. Students should be able to engage in various business, management, and international trade activities in government agencies or multinational companies. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Politics & Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Accounting, World Economics, International Trade Practice, Monetary Banking, Finance. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
